name: fix_spring_missing_validation
description: Wires a manual validator into a controller that accepts every registration
prompts: POST /register accepts any body and always returns 201 - RegistrationValidator exists but is never used and its rules are unimplemented. Fix the validation across two files: (1) implement RegistrationValidator.validate(username, age) (src/main/java/com/optarena/app/RegistrationValidator.java) to return null when valid, otherwise a short error message, enforcing: username must be non-null and not blank; age must be non-null and between 13 and 120 inclusive. (2) in RegistrationController, call the validator and, when it returns an error, respond HTTP 400 with JSON {"error": <message>} instead of creating the registration. A valid registration still returns 201 with {"username", "age"}. Do not add new Maven dependencies (there is no jakarta.validation on the offline classpath) - keep the validation manual.
